name: Translation
tagline: Draft translations using your glossary and reference material, then review the wording.

useCases.title: First-pass document translation
useCases.description: Draft a translation of a whole document from your glossary, for you to review and refine.

useCases.title: Terminology consistency check
useCases.description: Scan a finished translation against your termbase and flag every place a term diverges from the approved equivalent.

useCases.title: Back-translation for QA
useCases.description: Translate the target text back into the source language so a reviewer can verify meaning was preserved before delivery.

useCases.title: Bilingual glossary extraction
useCases.description: Pull source and target term pairs from past translations into a glossary you can reuse and grow over time.

useCases.title: Localized formatting and units
useCases.description: Adapt dates, currencies, measurements, and address formats to the target locale while keeping the translated meaning unchanged.

useCases.title: One source, many languages
useCases.description: Translate one file into several languages in one workflow, each with its own glossary.

faq.q: Will Ryu keep my client glossary consistent?
faq.a: Yes. Add your termbase and style guide to a Space, and Ryu translates from them, so approved terms are reused and you can see when something diverges.

faq.q: Can I keep confidential source documents private?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, source text stays on your machine. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.

faq.q: Does Ryu replace a human translator?
faq.a: No. Ryu drafts translations and runs consistency checks; a human translator reviews and finalizes every delivery.
